key_idea: A mirror swaps left and right, but it does not move things up or down.
steps: On the T-shirt, the star is on the left, the circle is on the right and the triangle is under the star.
In the mirror, left and right swap: the circle is on the left and the star is on the right.
The triangle stays under the star, so it moves to the right too.
A shows the circle on the left, the star on the right and the triangle under the star.

choice_feedback.B: This is the T-shirt without any swap.
choice_feedback.C: The triangle moved up to the top. A mirror does not move things up.
choice_feedback.D: All the shapes are bunched together on one side.
choice_feedback.E: The triangle moved up to the top. A mirror does not move things up.
